positive_controls.reason: The hash helper is tested for four set-like fields, but the required sequential and concurrent Start calls over all seven reordered/deduplicated fields are absent.
The suites exercise a successful inconclusive execution and one reopen, but do not read after every confirmed transition or prove byte-identical terminal persistence.
Pagination, repeatability and a changed limit are exercised on one open store; continuation of the same cursor after reopen is absent.

There is no integrated witness for queued withdrawal versus dequeue, RUNNING to CANCELLING, worker acknowledgement, duplicate-signal suppression under concurrency, and the no-new-provider-call boundary.
Tool names and schemas are inspected, but all three legacy tools are not invoked and the same injected RecommendationService object is not observed through both synchronous and asynchronous routes.

violated_cases.witness: TestStep0026ConcurrentStartCreatesAndCommitsExactlyOnce launches 32 concurrent starts and requires one durable create and one queue commit.
TestStep0026LocalQueueValidatesLimitsAndCommitCannotFailForCapacity reserves the last slot and requires Commit to succeed while the queue is at capacity.
TestStep0026ExecutePublishesBeforeSucceededAndPreservesInconclusive requires SUCCEEDED plus the unchanged INCONCLUSIVE recommendation status.
TestStep0026StateMachineAllowsOnlyFrozenArcsAndMonotonicProgress enumerates all lifecycle pairs and rejects every pair outside the frozen table.
TestStep0026ConcurrentStartCreatesAndCommitsExactlyOnce requires Start to return without invoking the executor.
TestStep0026FileStorePublishesFullDocumentHashAndPaginatesBoundCursor compares hash and size against the complete compact document bytes.
TestStep0026FileStorePublishesFullDocumentHashAndPaginatesBoundCursor rejects the same cursor when crossed to another run or artifact.
TestStep0026FileStorePublishesFullDocumentHashAndPaginatesBoundCursor continues a limit-1 cursor with limit 2 and verifies the stored offset.
The store suite verifies ordered pagination, last-page null cursor and repeated equality; the MCP suite requires entries to be injected JSON values.

survivor_groups.reason: Identity, retry, normalization and pre-effect coverage is partial: no generated-ID entropy/input-correlation witness; no advanced retry receipt; only four of seven set-like fields and one semantic delta are hashed; no real-store concurrent CreateOrResolve barrier; validation is not exhaustive across all fields/operations; queue-full does not count ID generation; quota-full does not count executor access or scan durable bytes.

Lifecycle, cancellation and concurrency witnesses are incomplete: terminal operations and republish-after-terminal are not exhaustively exercised; real FileStore CAS is not raced; version/progress variants remain untested; goroutine growth and store limits are absent; queued/running cancellation boundaries, terminal-result publication races, concurrent cancel idempotency, all orphan states, recovery ordering and shutdown uncertainty are absent; readiness/terminal matrix, pending/orphan visibility and blob hash/size corruption are not injected.

Artifact/store witnesses lack failure-prefix injection and breadth: no stop before each terminal prerequisite, missing-terminal-artifact matrix, complete cursor tamper/offset/version/hash/reopen-secret audit, digest-path mapping check for valid IDs, per-component symlink/hardlink and non-regular checks, crash-prefix model, concurrent quota accounting/eviction check, full disk/log privacy scan, complete raw-source canary traversal, or terminal-failure sanitization.

Closed JSON coverage is not exhaustive; no executable AST/import/forbidden-call audit is present; the Step 0025 comparison derives its legacy baseline from the same candidate server instead of a manifest-bound immutable golden and does not invoke the legacy tools; shared synchronous/asynchronous object identity is not observed; filesystem-kind checks are partial; valid missing lookup and all non-success terminal projections are not exercised.

opaque_cases.reason: The verifier observed btrfs identity but did not control or prove rename behavior at a power/crash boundary.
No controllable power-loss, device cache or storage-controller boundary was available.
The frozen suites provide no instrumented happens-before trace around provider cancellation observation.
Finite black-box ID samples cannot establish 128 bits of generator entropy.
Forced-process-removal ordering relative to shutdown and final fsync is not observable here.

unknown_policy_audit.negative_unknown_treatment: Every missing or ambiguous negative witness is counted as a surviving mutation, never as success.

stability_audit.reason: No frozen driver executes all 70 cases three times in the three declared orders or compares normalized witnesses. Ordinary Go test order does not establish the declared adversarial stability property.

findings: The L4 oracle freezes and directly calls the unexported helper newDurableMCPServer, coupling acceptance to a private composition-helper name and signature instead of only observable server behavior.

The legacy compatibility oracle obtains its comparison baseline from the same candidate implementation with durable support disabled; without a manifest-bound immutable Step 0025 golden execution, a shared regression can compare equal to itself.

seal.reason: A seal is forbidden until all valid negative mutations are independently Violated with mutation_score 1.0 and stable witnesses.
